data: Metz 1959. Michel, un respectable notaire de province et sa femme Hélène, qui partage son temps entre les œuvres caritatives et l'éducation de leur fils, forment un couple exemplaire. Le tableau serait banal si Michel ne dissimulait un lourd secret : tous les week-ends, il s'absente dans sa résidence secondaire, pour devenir Mylène sous le regard de Flavia, travesti expérimenté et ancien camarade de la drôle de guerre. Sous son influence, le lieu devient la Villa Mimi, point de ralliement d’une petite communauté d’hommes qui jouent librement à être des femmes… (Metz 1959. Michel, a respectable, provincial solicitor, and his wife Hélène, who keeps herself busy with charity work and educating their son, form an exemplary couple. They would make for a dull painting, if it weren't for the fact that Michel hides a dark secret: every weekend he disappears to a second home to become Mylène, under the watchful eye of Flavia, an experienced transvestite and former comrade from the war. Under his influence, house becomes Villa Mimi, a rallying point for a small community of men who freely act out being women...)

Metz 1959. Michel, a respectable, provincial solicitor, and his wife Hélène, who keeps herself busy with charity work and educating their son, form an exemplary couple. They would make for a dull painting, if it weren't for the fact that Michel hides a dark secret: every weekend he disappears to a second home to become Mylène, under the watchful eye of Flavia, an experienced transvestite and former comrade from the war. Under his influence, house becomes Villa Mimi, a rallying point for a small community of men who freely act out being women...
